prompt:
A standard external-hex coupling nut consists of an elongated hexagonal prismatic body with a plain cylindrical through hole running along the central axis.

The hex body size and overall length are governed by hex_width_across_flats and overall_length.

The axial clearance passage is defined by through_hole_diameter and extends through the full length set by overall_length.

Key parameters:
- overall_length = 30mm
- hex_width_across_flats = 17mm
- through_hole_diameter = 10mm
